title: Mithras Marvelous Mod
description: A mod that adds various foods to the game in a vanilla friendly way.
body:
This mod needs Minecraft 26.2 Fabric Loader and Fabric API.
It adds the following food items to the game:
Bananas, Oranges, Lettuce, Tomatoes, Tomato Sauce, Baked Beetroots, Baked Carrots, Fried Eggs, Cheese, Butter, Wheat Flour, Hearty Soup, Big Burger, Pizza, Fruit Salad and Chocolate Bar.
Both Bananas and Oranges are obtained like the vanilla Apple: destroy leaves to make them drop.
Bananas drop from Jungle Leaves and Oranges drop from Acacia Leaves.
Lettuce and Tomatoes can be obtained by planting their respective seeds found by breaking bushes and short grass.
All "advanced" foods can be made within vanilla blocks(Crafting Table, Furnace/Smoker/Campfire).
